question: When does liberation while living become directly present?
premises: Buddhi-based ignorance can expand and dominate cognition.
Buddhi-based knowledge can dissolve that ignorance.
The removal of that ignorance has an immediate existential effect.
inference: Therefore when buddhi-based knowledge dissolves buddhi-based ignorance, liberation while living stands immediately present.
plain_english: But when buddhi-based knowledge dissolves the swelling of buddhi-based ignorance, liberation while living is right there, as if placed on the palm of the hand.
